text: Wrong root cause and wrong probe shape: P5 ran --test-threads=1, but CI runs the 12 tests in parallel on 4 vCPUs; sibling contention is SUSTAINED, raises the minimum too, and min_of alone cannot undo it (perf_bounds.rs:250-258). Serialize the timed tests (a file-wide mutex) and re-measure in the CI shape (opus I1+I2, sol #2)
evidence: P7/P8 measured the CI shape (4-core pinned, 5 runs parallel vs serial: compute_summaries_v2 min 54-71 vs 44-47 ms, median 61-93 vs 45-48). Design change 1: TIMING_LOCK held as the first line of every timing test, setup included; root cause rewritten. Round 2: accepted by both.

text: 'Fails on a real 3x regression' was redefined against the bound's own baseline (circular: 3x76=228=the bound) and the 6x injection does not prove 3x; locally a 3x regression passes (3x43.6=131<230). Prove an exact 3x where it fails, and state where it does not (sol #1, opus I4). Round 2 (sol re-raised, opus N1): the runner claim rests on the PRE-lock ~150 ms min; the lock may lower it enough that 3x passes, and D3 had no stated outcome for that case
evidence: Round 1: D2 records that an exact 3x passes on the dev machine; D3 injects an exact 3x on the runner. Round 2: the honesty statement is now conditional with a rule decided in advance: D3's 3x FAILS on the runner -> acceptance met there; PASSES -> acceptance NOT met, back to design (re-baseline that bound to 3x the post-lock runner min, or a ratio gate), never a reworded claim; the trip factor in the code docs is written from D3's measured numbers. Round 5: sol re-raised (the probe times two discarded results whose drops fall inside the timed region; keep all three until timing stops and measure the real multiplier in D3b). Round 6: D3b keeps every result until start.elapsed() and drops it after, in both the 1x and 3x loops, and records the measured multiplier.

text: One green PR run does not show 'green across repeated CI runs of an unchanged head'; the file's own standard is 10/10 green (perf_bounds.rs:276-281) (sol #2, opus I3)

text: 'Only noise is filtered out' overclaims: the minimum also hides a regression that slows only some calls; describe the gates as best-case tripwires for consistent slowdowns (sol #3)
evidence: Design section 'What the gates still catch, stated honestly': best-case magnitude tripwire for a consistent slowdown; a partial slowdown can pass; other tenants' sustained load is still not filtered. Round 2: accepted by both.

evidence: P6 now says 'observed elapsed-time ratio' and that it mixes speed with contention; Design change 3 rewrites min_of's doc: drop the hyperfine/Criterion claim, say the minimum rejects transient positive delays and does nothing for a sustained window.
